22use crate::common::Result;
23use crate::Exceptions;

25use super::{GenericGFPoly, GenericGFRef};

27/**
28 * <p>Implements Reed-Solomon encoding, as the name implies.</p>
29 *
30 * @author Sean Owen
31 * @author William Rucklidge
32 */
33pub struct ReedSolomonEncoder {
34    field: GenericGFRef,
35    cachedGenerators: Vec<GenericGFPoly>,
36}
37
38impl ReedSolomonEncoder {
39    pub fn new(field: GenericGFRef) -> Result<Self> {
40        let n = field;
41        Ok(Self {
42            cachedGenerators: vec![GenericGFPoly::new(n, &[1])?],
43            field: n,
44        })
45    }
46
47    fn buildGenerator(&mut self, degree: usize) -> Option<&GenericGFPoly> {
48        if degree >= self.cachedGenerators.len() {
49            let mut lastGenerator = self.cachedGenerators.last()?;
50            let cg_len = self.cachedGenerators.len();
51            let mut nextGenerator;
52            for d in cg_len..=degree {
53                //for (int d = cachedGenerators.size(); d <= degree; d++) {
54                nextGenerator = lastGenerator
55                    .multiply(
56                        &GenericGFPoly::new(
57                            self.field,
58                            &[
59                                1,
60                                self.field.exp(d as i32 - 1 + self.field.getGeneratorBase()),
61                            ],
62                        )
63                        .ok()?,
64                    )
65                    .ok()?;
66                self.cachedGenerators.push(nextGenerator);
67                lastGenerator = self.cachedGenerators.get(d)?;
68                //lastGenerator = &nextGenerator;
69            }
70        }
71        let rv = self.cachedGenerators.get(degree)?;
72        Some(rv)
73    }
74
75    pub fn encode(&mut self, to_encode: &mut [i32], ec_bytes: usize) -> Result<()> {
76        if ec_bytes == 0 {
77            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
78                "No error correction bytes",
79            ));
80        }
81        let data_bytes = to_encode.len() - ec_bytes;
82        if data_bytes == 0 {
83            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with("No data bytes provided"));
84        }
85        let fld = self.field;
86        let generator = self.buildGenerator(ec_bytes);
87        let mut info_coefficients: Vec<i32> = vec![0; data_bytes];
88        info_coefficients[0..data_bytes].clone_from_slice(&to_encode[0..data_bytes]);
89        //System.arraycopy(toEncode, 0, infoCoefficients, 0, dataBytes);
90        let mut info = GenericGFPoly::new(fld, &info_coefficients)?;
91        info = info.multiply_by_monomial(ec_bytes, 1)?;
92        let remainder = &info.divide(generator.ok_or(Exceptions::REED_SOLOMON)?)?.1;
93        let coefficients = remainder.getCoefficients();
94        let num_zero_coefficients = ec_bytes - coefficients.len();
95        for i in 0..num_zero_coefficients {
96            //for (int i = 0; i < numZeroCoefficients; i++) {
97            to_encode[data_bytes + i] = 0;
98        }
99        to_encode[data_bytes + num_zero_coefficients
100            ..(coefficients.len() + data_bytes + num_zero_coefficients)]
101            .clone_from_slice(&coefficients[0..coefficients.len()]);
102        //System.arraycopy(coefficients, 0, toEncode, dataBytes + numZeroCoefficients, coefficients.length);
103        Ok(())
104    }
105}
